title: Creative asset — what we made, what it said, what it earned
note: ONE ITEM PER ASSET (the reviewable unit); the ad unit — the 13-field ad_name — stays the spend join and is a body field, because the 130-char asset name does not fit ITEM_ID_RE. Item id `<batch>.<slug>.a<nn>` for a delivered asset, `<batch>.<slug>.r<n>` for a reject. Append-only event history folded on read (serve_records history, same as tasks). Events: `made` — MACHINE ONLY (reviewer image-production or a lane's record-keeper): identity (the 13 fields + lane + sub), template, copy.slots + copy.provenance declared|ocr|unknown, hook, offer{id, bar_text}, prompt, model{requested, reported}, references, location{drive_id, drive_path, durable_url}, qc{status, checks_run, fails, judge_model, coverage}. `signed` — HUMAN ONLY: a pointer to the output-review verdict that approved the sub-avatar mapping. `status` — HUMAN ONLY: offered | control-ran | picked | testing | validated | retired (the hook-ledger vocabulary, verbatim) plus `evidence`. `note` — HUMAN ONLY: the why, the LEARN half of the loop. RULES: a `made` record NEVER reads as approval (qc-verdicts precedent); no record stores money — spend joins at read via ad_name against platform/data/metrics/<run>/data.json, and until the ad-level Meta pull exists (AW-10, warehouse owner) every view says MADE, NOT WORKED; `unknown` is written, never blank; `sub` is null when undeclared, never guessed. Owner the owner (lab/the owner/creative-ledger); written by components/naming/record.py. Records live under lab/the owner/creative-ledger/records/ until the developer rules on a lab tool writing platform/data/records/ (precedent: teardown_adapter.py standalone) — same shape either way.

verdict_fields.note: exactly one per record. `made` is machine-only; the other three are human-only and carry the person in `reviewer`.
the 14-field asset name; drop the last field for the ad unit
the 13-field ad unit — Meta's Ad name; the spend join
the 13 fields parsed, plus lane and sub (null when undeclared)
layout template path, or `prompted` when the layout lived only in the prompt. `format` in the name IS the layout template; the copy bank's notion is `copy_kind`.
{text, source_row} — the language-bank row the headline came from, when known
{id, bar_text} — copied from the offer bank, never typed from memory; no price stored unless it was on the pixels
{text, path} — verbatim when kept; `unknown` when it was not
{requested, reported} — e.g. nano_banana_pro requested, nano_banana_2 reported
[{role, ref}] — cast Element, product Element, image_references for an edit
{status: pass|reject, checks_run[], fails[], judge_model, coverage} — coverage says which checks actually ran
the output-review record that carries the human verdict
the hook-ledger vocabulary; `evidence` says on what
what the status rests on — a Meta report, a date, a decision; never a number of dollars

_items_note: SEED ONLY, deliberately empty — every asset is record-borne (open_items). Views discover items from the records, never from this list.
